acceptance_criteria.criterion: the trusted replay worker resolves every candidate import, bare and package-qualified, inside the candidate checkout, and never loads code from the trusted default-branch checkout
acceptance_criteria.evidence: isolated_import_path removes the trusted scripts directory and its parent repository root (including the empty cwd entry) and prepends the candidate root and scripts directory; package-qualified and bare import regression tests cover it.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: a candidate helper the candidate did not ship fails closed with an import error instead of silently importing the trusted base checkout's copy
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Removing the trusted root makes an unshipped package-qualified helper an ImportError; test_missing_candidate_helper_fails_closed_instead_of_importing_the_trusted_base proves no base fallback.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: the candidate-module digest the receipt binds is reproducible from an independent fresh checkout of the same candidate head
acceptance_criteria.evidence: candidate_module_digest hashes the whole candidate scripts tree and verify_candidate_module_digests recomputes it from an independent fresh checkout; unchanged by this fix.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: mutating the candidate scripts tree during scenario execution is detected and fails the scenario closed, rather than reporting a pristine-tree digest for bytes that were not executed
acceptance_criteria.evidence: main() re-takes the digest after the scenario and fails the scenario closed when it differs; test_main_fails_closed_when_the_candidate_tree_mutates_during_execution and the positive control cover it.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: focused deterministic tests cover candidate import-path confinement and executed-tree mutation detection
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Focused tests added in tests/test_hunter_trusted_orchestrator_replay.py; the suite passes (106 passed).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: the complete base-to-head diff is subjected to the applicable dpm defect-family checks and an independent exact-head hostile review request; the request is not represented as completed reviewer authority
acceptance_criteria.evidence: This request lists the 19 applicable DPM families for the changed paths; an independent exact-head hostile review is requested, never represented as completed reviewer authority.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: no automatic merge occurs, and no claim is made that this bootstrap resolves the broader untrusted-candidate sandbox, publisher, or workflow-binding gaps tracked for the main replay change
acceptance_criteria.evidence: This is a minimal base-owned bootstrap; it performs no automatic merge and does not claim to resolve the broader untrusted-candidate sandbox, publisher, or workflow-binding gaps.
